# Islamic Lives

A sourced collection of people in Islamic scripture and history.

- [People dataset](/data/people.json)
- [Quran mention index](/data/quran-mentions.json)
- [Coverage and limitations](/data/coverage.json)
- [Research approach](/#about)

Religious reports, historical claims, and uncertainty notes are labelled separately. Do not treat the collection as exhaustive or as a source of religious rulings.
